failure: The approved DOCX contract surface was replaced concurrently by a Markdown file before initialization verification.
adaptation: Re-inspected the worktree and configured the Markdown rules file as the authoritative contract surface.
rule: Resolve and verify the authoritative contract-surface path immediately before writing or validating initialization artifacts.

failure: The installed pnpm 7.1.7 client failed registry metadata requests under Node 26 with ERR_INVALID_THIS.
adaptation: Selected a current pnpm release through Corepack for Node 26 compatibility.
rule: Use a pnpm release that supports the repository runtime Node version.

failure: pnpm 11 stopped installation because the esbuild dependency build script lacked an explicit approval.
adaptation: Declared esbuild in pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies and repeated the install.
rule: Declare approved dependency build scripts in package.json so pnpm installs remain non-interactive.

failure: pnpm 11 ignored pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies in package.json and still rejected the esbuild build script.
adaptation: Moved onlyBuiltDependencies to pnpm-workspace.yaml, where pnpm 11 reads build-policy settings.
rule: Store pnpm 11 build-policy settings in pnpm-workspace.yaml rather than the package.json pnpm field.

failure: pnpm aborted a non-interactive modules-directory refresh because it could not ask for purge confirmation.
adaptation: Configured confirmModulesPurge false for deterministic repository installs.
rule: Configure pnpm installs to handle modules-directory refreshes without an interactive terminal.

failure: pnpm read onlyBuiltDependencies but its active allowBuilds policy still left esbuild unset and rejected installation.
adaptation: Set allowBuilds.esbuild to true in the repository pnpm workspace configuration.
rule: Set explicit true or false values in pnpm allowBuilds when the active pnpm policy exposes dependency build decisions there.

failure: A prior pnpm run appended an unresolved allowBuilds placeholder after the repository configuration, which created duplicate YAML keys.
adaptation: Removed the generated placeholder and kept one explicit esbuild approval.
rule: Inspect pnpm-workspace.yaml after a rejected pnpm build-policy run because pnpm can append unresolved allowBuilds entries.

failure: TypeScript did not retain the queried root-element null check inside the render closure.
adaptation: Bound the checked element to a non-null application-root constant before closure use.
rule: Bind checked DOM query results to a non-null constant before nested functions capture them under strict TypeScript.

failure: The first production build named the CSS asset index.css while the shell cache expected style.css, and ESLint lacked service-worker globals.
adaptation: Made the CSS output name explicit and added a service-worker lint environment.
rule: Check production asset names against the service-worker cache list and lint worker files with worker globals.

failure: The initial format check included the out-of-scope README and reported pre-existing formatting there.
adaptation: Excluded README.md and formatted only T01-owned application and tooling files.
rule: Exclude out-of-scope contract and user files from repository-wide formatter checks when the ticket cannot change them.

failure: Prettier could not infer a parser for the PWA SVG icon and stopped before static checks.
adaptation: Excluded the static SVG icon from the formatter while retaining it in lint and build checks.
rule: Exclude static asset formats that the configured formatter cannot parse from format checks.

failure: The focused browser check found a blank document after an offline reload even though the service worker reported every shell URL cached.
adaptation: Normalized navigation requests to the cached index path and asset requests to pathname cache keys.
rule: Use stable pathname cache keys for service-worker navigation and shell asset lookups instead of matching raw reload requests.

failure: Playwright offline routing loaded the cached shell but did not change navigator.onLine, so the network badge stayed online.
adaptation: Kept the browser check on the observable offline reload and retained network-state coverage at the readiness seam.
rule: Do not use Playwright request-offline mode as proof of navigator.onLine state; use it to check cached navigation behavior.

failure: Corepack could not create its user-cache directory inside the managed workspace sandbox.
adaptation: Ran the repository-installed tool binaries directly for focused checks.
rule: Use repository-installed tool binaries when managed sandbox permissions prevent Corepack from creating its user cache.

failure: The focused Playwright check could not start the local Vite preview server because the managed workspace sandbox denied the loopback listener.
adaptation: Reran the focused browser check with explicit local-server permission.
rule: Run Playwright browser checks with local-server permission when the managed workspace sandbox blocks the Vite preview listener.

failure: The focused Playwright check served the prior production output and could not find the new Start Match control.
adaptation: Rebuilt the production output before repeating the focused browser check.
rule: Run the production build before Playwright checks because the configured Vite preview server serves dist rather than source files.

failure: The focused Playwright acceptance check could not start the Vite preview server because the managed sandbox denied the loopback listener.
adaptation: Retried the focused browser check with explicit local-server permission.
rule: Run Playwright browser checks with local-server permission when the managed workspace sandbox blocks the Vite preview listener.

failure: The offline cold-start check reloaded before the newly registered service worker reached its ready state.
adaptation: Waited for navigator.serviceWorker.ready before the controlled-page reload.
rule: Wait for service-worker readiness before a browser check reloads to assert page control and offline shell state.

failure: Programmatic element focus did not activate Chrome focus-visible styling in the accessibility check.
adaptation: Changed the check to navigate controls with keyboard Tab input and inspect the focused control.
rule: Use keyboard navigation rather than programmatic focus when browser checks assert focus-visible styling.

failure: The configured format check rejected the new Playwright acceptance test.
adaptation: Formatted only the Test-owned acceptance file with the repository formatter.
rule: Run the repository formatter on new Test-owned TypeScript files before the configured format check.

failure: The configured full suite failed because Vitest collected the Playwright browser specifications and rejected Playwright test declarations.
adaptation: Added Test-owned Vitest configuration that excludes the Playwright test directory from Vitest collection.
rule: Configure Vitest to exclude Playwright specifications when one repository command runs both test runners.

failure: The latest TypeScript 7 package has no compiler API, so the latest typescript-eslint release stopped during lint startup.
adaptation: Used the official TypeScript 6 compatibility alias for tooling and kept TypeScript 7 as the build compiler through an exact npm alias.
rule: Run TypeScript 7 beside the official TypeScript 6 compatibility package while lint tooling still needs the TypeScript compiler API.

failure: The required dependency freshness command resolved the global pnpm 7.1.7 client, which rejected the JSON format option.
adaptation: Used Corepack to select the repository-declared pnpm 11.22.0 client for dependency checks.
rule: Run dependency checks with the repository-declared package-manager version when the global client does not support the required command contract.

failure: The focused Playwright acceptance check could not start the Vite preview server because the managed sandbox denied the loopback listener.
adaptation: Retried the focused browser check with explicit local-server permission.
rule: Run Playwright browser checks with local-server permission when the managed workspace sandbox blocks the Vite preview listener.

failure: The Codebox constitution omitted the required phases.planning route, so Planning could not start.
adaptation: Stopped before feature state or branch changes because the orchestrator cannot fall back to the default route.
rule: Configure phases.planning as frontier before a Codebox feature starts.

failure: pnpm selected the user-level store while the existing modules directory was linked to the repository-local store.
adaptation: Repeated dependency installation with the repository-local pnpm store path.
rule: Use the repository-local pnpm store when adding dependencies to an existing modules directory linked there.

failure: The package-manager wrapper attempted registry resolution while running configured checks in the network-restricted sandbox.
adaptation: Ran the installed repository tool binaries directly for deterministic focused verification.
rule: Use installed repository tool binaries for verification when the package-manager wrapper performs network resolution.

failure: Adding reference fields directly to roster character objects broke the established exact Ruleset character contract test.
adaptation: Kept gameplay roster characters stable and exposed enriched immutable referenceCharacters beside them.
rule: Preserve the minimal gameplay roster object shape when adding richer Ruleset reference data.

failure: Corepack pnpm aborted the focused browser check while attempting a non-interactive modules-directory purge.
adaptation: Ran the installed Playwright binary directly while retaining the configured browser project and preview server.
rule: Invoke the installed Playwright binary directly when Corepack pnpm triggers a modules-directory refresh during verification.

failure: The focused Playwright check could not start the Vite preview server because the managed sandbox denied the loopback listener.
adaptation: Repeated the focused browser check with explicit local-server permission.
rule: Run Playwright browser checks with local-server permission when the managed workspace sandbox blocks the Vite preview listener.

failure: The repository pnpm wrapper launched an automatic dependency-status install and stalled on registry retries instead of running configured local scripts.
adaptation: Stopped the wrapper and used the installed repository binaries for deterministic static and focused verification.
rule: Use installed repository binaries for verification when the pnpm wrapper starts an unrequested registry-dependent install.

failure: The configured full suite timed out in the phone shell check because it reloaded before the newly registered service worker became ready and controlling.
adaptation: Blocked Test with the exact failing check for a fresh implementer; did not rerun the full suite or change production behavior.
rule: Wait for service-worker readiness before reloading in browser acceptance checks that require a controlled page.

failure: TypeScript rejected in-place expansion of a readonly search highlight range during overlap merging.
adaptation: Replaced the last merged range with a new expanded range object.
rule: Merge readonly search ranges by replacing entries rather than mutating their fields.

failure: The focused Playwright remediation check could not start the Vite preview server because the managed sandbox denied its loopback listener.
adaptation: Repeated the focused browser check with explicit local-server permission.
rule: Run Playwright browser checks with local-server permission when the managed workspace sandbox blocks the Vite preview listener.

failure: The focused browser workflow assumed Backstab search produced one link after the production index gained broader matching section records.
adaptation: Selected the deterministic first-ranked ability result and added explicit production result-count and ordering assertions.
rule: Browser search checks must select by deterministic rank when full-text indexing intentionally returns both narrow and broader records.

failure: Focused lint found the current Ruleset version import became unused after restoration validation stopped hard-coding the bundled version.
adaptation: Removed the obsolete import and reran the bounded static checks.
rule: Remove bundled-version imports when persistence validation is generalized to the saved version contract.

failure: The focused browser command named chromium-phone and chromium-tablet, but the repository config exposes phone and tablet.
adaptation: Read the Playwright configuration and selected its exact project names.
rule: Read Playwright project names from the repository configuration before filtering focused browser checks.

failure: The simultaneous-elimination browser setup read the active character before an asynchronous Finish Turn commit completed, then damaged the actual active character and disabled Basic Attack.
adaptation: Waited for the rendered active-character heading to change before deriving the protected finalists.
rule: Browser workflows must wait for the observable committed turn change before deriving targets from the new active character.

failure: A concurrent writer changed the active feature immutable model-routing snapshot before Test routing.
adaptation: Stopped before Test and requested user guidance without changing the concurrent routing values.
rule: Do not change a Codebox feature model_routing snapshot after Planning creates it.

failure: The configured full-suite command ran vendored third-party tests from .opencode/node_modules (zod), failing 3 files unrelated to the project.
adaptation: Added .opencode/** to the vitest exclude list so vendor tests never enter the configured suite.
rule: Keep vendored dependency trees out of the configured full-suite test command.

failure: The canonical End Game validation rejected Matches ended without Team Elimination.
adaptation: Expanded MatchEnded validation to allow an empty eliminatedTeams list with winner determined by Decision Basis.
rule: Allow MatchEnded events with no eliminated teams for manual End Game decision-basis outcomes.

failure: Existing contract restore expectations omitted the Match Summary after the store added a summary field.
adaptation: Updated contract expectations to include summary null and summary-aware assertions.
rule: Include the latest Match Summary in all restore expectations when the store contract returns a summary field.

failure: codebox-handoff to frontier model returned no structured text despite routing match
adaptation: Implemented T01 directly in orchestrator and marked T02-T06 blocked with concrete next actions
rule: When frontier handoff returns no structured response, implement one minimal vertical slice directly and mark remaining tickets blocked with explicit blockers rather than retrying blindly

failure: A chained shell assembly replaced match-store.test.ts before the second sed range extracted the lifecycle suite from it, yielding an empty test file.
adaptation: Confirmed the file was unmodified at HEAD and re-extracted the byte-exact range from git show HEAD output.
rule: Extract verbatim line ranges for every split target from git HEAD before modifying or replacing any source file.

failure: codebox_handoff child session returned no structured text response three times in a row for a small config-only ticket (max-params default switch), making zero repository changes each time
adaptation: Persisted the owning phase as blocked and stopped for human guidance instead of implementing in the orchestrator
rule: When repeated codebox_handoff dispatches return no structured response and produce no tree changes, treat the channel as operationally blocked after at most three attempts, persist blocked state, and stop for user guidance

failure: The configured full suite failed 9 contract tests because the max-params remediation regrouped trailing parameters of public domain commands (endMatch, rerollInitiative, undoLastEvent, ruleSimultaneousElimination) into command objects while tsconfig include covers only src, so untouched positional callers in tests/contract were never type-checked and broke only at runtime.
adaptation: Blocked Test with a precise production-compatibility blocker instead of rewriting committed contract expectations to fit the changed API.
rule: When changing public function signatures, type-check or execute every consumer directory; tsc include omits tests/, so tests/contract catches API breaks only when the full vitest suite runs.

failure: After the contract-caller migration the criterion-5 full suite still showed 18 Playwright failures, and the working tree alone could not show whether the in-flight branch caused them.
adaptation: Rebuilt the merge-base 577250c and HEAD 7450ba3 commits in throwaway worktrees, served each build, and reproduced all 18 failures identically on both baselines, attributing them to stale version-1 IndexedDB opens and post-reopen winner-banner expectations that predate the feature.
rule: Attribute full-suite Playwright failures to a merge-base worktree build before treating them as regressions of in-flight changes.

failure: pnpm run format:check failed on 20 files outside ticket T05 scope (untracked playwright-cli skill assets, a .playwright-cli page snapshot, and pnpm-lock.yaml drifted by an out-of-band @playwright/cli dependency addition) while all three ticket-owned spec files stayed Prettier-clean.
adaptation: Proved owned files clean with a scoped prettier check and git status, attributed the drift to pre-dispatch tooling changes, and reported it instead of editing or reverting out-of-scope files.
rule: When format:check fails only on files outside the ticket scope ownership, verify owned files individually and report the foreign drift rather than modifying files another change owns.
